title: Evaluation
description: Evaluation of a user's answer to a quiz question

isCorrect.description: Whether the answer is correct (or substantially correct)

score.description: Score from 0.0 to 1.0 for partial credit

keyPointsCovered.description: Which key points the user's answer addressed

keyPointsMissing.description: Which key points were missing from the answer

misconceptions.description: Identified misconceptions in the user's answer

feedback.description: Specific, constructive feedback on the answer

explanation.description: Explanation of why the correct answer is correct

hints.description: Hints to guide understanding if incorrect
